articles.title: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation

articles.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
articles.summary: Microsoft Corp. today issued updates to plug at least 974 security holes in its Windows operating systems and other software, by far its biggest single patch batch ever.
